correctness.rationale: Semantic equivalence to coordinate-fiber cross-cover was proved for every n. A compactness-by-induction argument independently establishes finite character for all infinite teams; minimal finite failures produce pairwise diagonal Q/P tensor pairings, forcing size ≤2^n. Full Boolean cube is minimal failure of size 2^n; diagonal n+1 rows is minimal failure and no n-row team fails. The explicit at-most convention avoids ambiguity with exactly-k tests. The checker verified 788 exhaustive small teams, 268 random minimally noncoverable teams, and 30790 nontrivial tensor pairings; finite computations are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The natural n-fold distinct-constancy case generalizes the published two-atom coherence bound to arbitrary n and arbitrary alphabet sizes, with sharp exponential obstructions, a tensor certificate, an infinite-team theorem, and two extremal minimal failure configurations. It yields a finite-variable universal obstruction criterion and an exact quantitative database-integrity locality guarantee; the result is not merely the obvious FO coverability rewriting.
